text

Text。

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
user-select Boolean false No Whether the text is available. It causes the text node to be displayed as inline-block.
space String No Consecutive spaces.
decode Boolean false No Whether to decode.

Valid Values of space

Value Description
ensp Half of the size of a Chinese character space.
emsp Size of a Chinese character space.
nbsp Space size based on the font.

Sample Code


<view>
  <text userSelect=false space="nbsp">Chinese characters space nbsp</text>
</view>

Bug & Tip

  1. &nbsp, &lt, &gt, &amp, &apos, &ensp, and &emsp can be parsed by decode.
  2. The space standards vary according to OSs.
  3. The text component supports only text nesting.
  4. Only text nodes can be selected.
